planets.name: HD 77946 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 77946 with a 6.53-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: HD 77946 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 77946. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
